examples.sentence: C'est un enfant très curieux.
examples.translation: He/She is a very curious child.

examples.sentence: Si cet enfant dormait, nous ferions moins de bruit.
examples.translation: If this child slept, we would make less noise.

examples.sentence: Les enfants sont accompagnés par leurs parents.
examples.translation: Children are accompanied by their parents.

entries.intro: To make something visible, display a feature, or point out direction.
entries.usage: Regular -er verb. Conjugation: montre, montres, montre. Past participle: montré.

examples.sentence: Je montre mes photos de vacances.
examples.translation: I am showing my holiday photos.

examples.sentence: Il montre le chemin sur la carte.
examples.translation: He shows the way on the map.

examples.sentence: Si tu me montrais tes dessins, je serais ravi.
examples.translation: If you showed me your drawings, I would be delighted.

examples.sentence: Cette peinture a été montrée au musée.
examples.translation: This painting was shown at the museum.

entries.intro: To bring an action, task, or time to a conclusion. Cross-referenced with 'commencer' (to start).
entries.usage: Regular -ir (second conjugation) verb: finis, finis, finit, finissons, finissez, finissent. Past participle: fini.

examples.sentence: Je finis mes devoirs ce soir.
examples.translation: I am finishing my homework tonight.

examples.sentence: Le film finit à dix heures.
examples.translation: The movie ends at ten o'clock.

examples.sentence: Si tu finissais ton assiette, tu aurais un dessert.
examples.translation: If you finished your plate, you would have a dessert.

examples.sentence: Le match a été fini avant la pluie.
examples.translation: The match was finished before the rain.

entries.intro: To obtain or accept something given/sent, or to welcome guests at home.
entries.usage: Irregular: reçois, reçois, reçoit, recevons, recevez, reçoivent. Past participle: reçu.

examples.sentence: Je reçois une lettre de mon ami.
examples.translation: I receive a letter from my friend.

examples.sentence: Elle reçoit ses invités dans le salon.
examples.translation: She welcomes her guests in the living room.

examples.sentence: Si je recevais une promotion, je fêterais ça.
examples.translation: If I received a promotion, I would celebrate that.

examples.sentence: Ce paquet a été reçu hier matin.
examples.translation: This package was received yesterday morning.

entries.intro: Acts as a masculine noun meaning 'book', a feminine noun meaning 'pound' (weight/currency), or a regular verb meaning 'to deliver' (livrer).
entries.usage: As a noun, masculine: un livre (book); feminine: une livre (pound). Verb root is from 'livrer' (to deliver).

examples.sentence: Je lis un livre très intéressant.
examples.translation: I am reading a very interesting book.

examples.sentence: Achetez une livre de beurre.
examples.translation: Buy a pound of butter.

examples.sentence: Si j'avais un bon livre, je lirais toute la nuit.
examples.translation: If I had a good book, I would read all night.

examples.sentence: Le colis est livré par le facteur.
examples.translation: The package is delivered by the postman. (Verb 'livrer' passive)

entries.intro: A town, city, or urban area. Cross-referenced with 'pays' (#134) and 'rue' (#148).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: villes. 'En ville' (in town). Note: double 'l' is pronounced /l/.

examples.sentence: Paris est une grande ville.
examples.translation: Paris is a big city.

examples.sentence: Elle habite en ville.
examples.translation: She lives in town.

examples.sentence: Si cette ville était plus calme, j'y vivrais.
examples.translation: If this city were calmer, I would live there.

examples.sentence: La ville a été détruite pendant la guerre.
examples.translation: The city was destroyed during the war.

entries.intro: A group of parents and children, or relatives collectively.
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: familles. 'Famille d'accueil' (foster family). Double 'l' is pronounced /j/.

examples.sentence: J'aime passer du temps en famille.
examples.translation: I like spending time with family.

examples.sentence: Sa famille habite au Canada.
examples.translation: His/Her family lives in Canada.

examples.sentence: Si ma famille était ici, nous ferions une fête.
examples.translation: If my family were here, we would make a party.

examples.sentence: Ce secret de famille a été gardé pendant des années.
examples.translation: This family secret was kept for years.

entries.intro: A public street in a town/city. Cross-referenced with 'chemin' (#153) and 'ville' (#146).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: rues. 'Dans la rue' (in the street).

examples.sentence: Il marche dans la rue.
examples.translation: He is walking in the street.

examples.sentence: Cette rue est très bruyante.
examples.translation: This street is very noisy.

examples.sentence: Si la rue était barrée, nous prendrions un autre chemin.
examples.translation: If the street were blocked, we would take another path.

examples.sentence: La rue a été nettoyée ce matin.
examples.translation: The street was cleaned this morning.

entries.intro: Refers to something recently created, obtained, or changed. Cross-referenced with 'vieux' (#150).
entries.usage: Inflects: nouveau (m), nouvel (m before vowel/h), nouvelle (f), nouveaux (m pl), nouvelles (f pl). Precedes the noun.

examples.sentence: J'ai un nouveau téléphone.
examples.translation: I have a new phone.

examples.sentence: C'est une nouvelle méthode.
examples.translation: This is a new method.

examples.sentence: Si un nouvel élève arrivait, je l'accueillerais.
examples.translation: If a new student arrived, I would welcome him.

examples.sentence: Ce nouveau projet a été financé par la banque.
examples.translation: This new project was financed by the bank.

entries.intro: Refers to advanced age in persons, animals, or objects. Cross-referenced with 'nouveau' (#149) and opposite 'jeune' (#152).
entries.usage: Inflects: vieux (m), vieil (m before vowel/h), vieille (f), vieux (m pl), vieilles (f pl). Precedes the noun.

examples.sentence: Il vit dans un vieux château.
examples.translation: He lives in an old castle.

examples.sentence: C'est une vieille voiture.
examples.translation: This is an old car.

examples.sentence: Si ce vieil homme parlait, il nous raconterait l'histoire.
examples.translation: If this old man spoke, he would tell us the history.

examples.sentence: Les vieux livres sont restaurés par l'expert.
examples.translation: The old books are restored by the expert.

entries.intro: Aesthetic appreciation of a person, place, or nice weather. Opposite of 'laid' (ugly).
entries.usage: Inflects: beau (m), bel (m before vowel/h), belle (f), beaux (m pl), belles (f pl). Precedes the noun.

examples.sentence: Il fait beau aujourd'hui.
examples.translation: It is nice weather today.

examples.sentence: C'est une belle histoire.
examples.translation: This is a beautiful story.

examples.sentence: Si le paysage était beau, je le peindrais.
examples.translation: If the landscape were beautiful, I would paint it.

examples.sentence: Ce bel oiseau a été photographié par mon ami.
examples.translation: This beautiful bird was photographed by my friend.

entries.intro: Refers to early stage of life. Opposite of 'vieux' (#150).
entries.usage: Inflects: jeune (m/f), jeunes (pl). Precedes the noun.

examples.sentence: C'est un jeune homme plein d'ambition.
examples.translation: He is a young man full of ambition.

examples.sentence: Les jeunes mariés sont en voyage.
examples.translation: The newlyweds are on a trip.

examples.sentence: Si j'étais plus jeune, je ferais plus de sport.
examples.translation: If I were younger, I would do more sports.

examples.sentence: La jeune victime a été secourue à temps.
examples.translation: The young victim was rescued in time.

entries.intro: A physical path, track, route to a destination, or logical method. Cross-referenced with 'rue' (#148) and 'route'.
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: chemins. 'Chemin de fer' (railway).

examples.sentence: Ce chemin mène à la forêt.
examples.translation: This path leads to the forest.

examples.sentence: Nous avons perdu notre chemin.
examples.translation: We have lost our way.

examples.sentence: Si je connaissais le chemin, je te guiderais.
examples.translation: If I knew the path, I would guide you.

examples.sentence: Un nouveau chemin a été tracé par les randonneurs.
examples.translation: A new path was cleared by the hikers.

entries.intro: The feeling of deep affection or romance. Cross-referenced with verb 'aimer' (#124) and opposite 'haine' (hate).
entries.usage: Masculine noun in singular (un grand amour), but historically feminine in plural. Plural: amours.

examples.sentence: L'amour est plus fort que la haine.
examples.translation: Love is stronger than hate.

examples.sentence: Ils vivent une belle histoire d'amour.
examples.translation: They are living a beautiful love story.

examples.sentence: Si j'avais un grand amour dans ma vie, je serais comblé.
examples.translation: If I had a great love in my life, I would be fulfilled.

examples.sentence: L'amour a été célébré lors du mariage.
examples.translation: Love was celebrated during the wedding.

entries.intro: The sun, star at the center of the solar system, or sunlight. Cross-referenced with 'ciel' (#156).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: soleils. 'Coup de soleil' (sunburn). Final -il is pronounced as glide /j/.

examples.sentence: Le soleil brille aujourd'hui.
examples.translation: The sun shines today.

examples.sentence: J'aime m'allonger au soleil.
examples.translation: I like lying in the sun.

examples.sentence: Si le soleil brillait, nous sécherions le linge dehors.
examples.translation: If the sun shone, we would dry the laundry outside.

examples.sentence: Le soleil est caché par les nuages.
examples.translation: The sun is hidden by the clouds.

entries.intro: The sky, atmosphere visible from Earth, or heaven in religious contexts. Cross-referenced with 'soleil' (#155).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural is highly irregular: cieux (heavens/skies).

examples.sentence: Le ciel est bleu aujourd'hui.
examples.translation: The sky is blue today.

examples.sentence: Il y a des étoiles dans le ciel.
examples.translation: There are stars in the sky.

examples.sentence: Si le ciel était dégagé, nous verrions la lune.
examples.translation: If the sky were clear, we would see the moon.

examples.sentence: Le ciel a été peint en bleu par l'artiste.
examples.translation: The sky was painted blue by the artist.

entries.intro: Indicates a logical consequence (so/then) or a specific point in the past (at that time).
entries.usage: Invariable. 'Alors que' (while / whereas).

examples.sentence: Il pleut, alors je prends mon parapluie.
examples.translation: It is raining, so I am taking my umbrella.

examples.sentence: À cette époque-là, j'étais alors étudiant.
examples.translation: At that time, I was a student then.

examples.sentence: Si tu n'aimais pas ce repas, alors pourquoi l'as-tu fini?
examples.translation: If you didn't like this meal, then why did you finish it?

examples.sentence: La décision a été alors prise par le maire.
examples.translation: The decision was then taken by the mayor.

entries.intro: Preposition/adverb indicating spatial or temporal sequence following something. Opposite of 'avant' (#159).
entries.usage: Invariable. 'Après que' (after).

examples.sentence: Je t'appelle après le repas.
examples.translation: I will call you after the meal.

examples.sentence: Il est arrivé après moi.
examples.translation: He arrived after me.

examples.sentence: Si je t'appelais après minuit, tu dormirais.
examples.translation: If I called you after midnight, you would be sleeping.

examples.sentence: Le dessert est servi après le plat principal.
examples.translation: Dessert is served after the main dish.

entries.intro: Indicates spatial or temporal priority preceding something. Opposite of 'après' (#158).
entries.usage: Invariable. Requires 'de' before an infinitive; 'avant que' (requires subjunctive).

examples.sentence: Je finis mon travail avant la réunion.
examples.translation: I am finishing my work before the meeting.

examples.sentence: Il faut laver ses mains avant de manger.
examples.translation: You must wash your hands before eating.

examples.sentence: Si tu partais avant la tempête, tu éviterais le pire.
examples.translation: If you left before the storm, you would avoid the worst.

examples.sentence: Cette loi a été votée avant les élections.
examples.translation: This law was voted before the elections.

entries.intro: Means general currency/wealth (money) or the white metallic element (silver).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: argents (rare). Requires 'l'' (l'argent) in singular. Liaison /t/ in speech.

examples.sentence: Je n'ai pas d'argent sur moi.
examples.translation: I don't have money on me.

examples.sentence: Cette bague est en argent.
examples.translation: This ring is made of silver.

examples.sentence: Si j'avais assez d'argent, j'achèterais une voiture.
examples.translation: If I had enough money, I would buy a car.

examples.sentence: L'argent a été déposé à la banque.
examples.translation: The money was deposited at the bank.

entries.intro: A narrative/tale (story) or chronological record of past events (history).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: histoires. Requires 'l'' (l'histoire). Silent 'h'.

examples.sentence: Raconte-moi une histoire.
examples.translation: Tell me a story.

examples.sentence: Elle étudie l'histoire de France.
examples.translation: She studies the history of France.

examples.sentence: Si cette histoire était vraie, ce serait effrayant.
examples.translation: If this story were true, it would be scary.

examples.sentence: L'histoire is enseignée au collège.
examples.translation: History is taught in middle school.

entries.intro: The physical body of a human or animal, or a collective group.
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Ending in -s, spelling remains identical in singular and plural (le corps / les corps). Final -ps is silent.

examples.sentence: Le sport est bon pour le corps.
examples.translation: Sports are good for the body.

examples.sentence: Les médecins étudient le corps humain.
examples.translation: Doctors study the human body.

examples.sentence: Si mon corps était fatigué, je dormirais.
examples.translation: If my body were tired, I would sleep.

examples.sentence: Le corps a été retrouvé dans la forêt.
examples.translation: The body was found in the forest.

entries.intro: Denotes excess in quantity, size, or intensity. Cross-referenced with 'très' (#164).
entries.usage: Invariable. Requires 'de' before nouns. Liaison /p/.

examples.sentence: Cette veste est trop grande pour moi.
examples.translation: This jacket is too big for me.

examples.sentence: Il boit trop de café.
examples.translation: He drinks too much coffee.

examples.sentence: Si le loyer était too cher, nous déménagerions.
examples.translation: If the rent were too expensive, we would move.

examples.sentence: Ce problème a été trop négligé par les autorités.
examples.translation: This problem was neglected too much by the authorities.

entries.intro: Intensifier placed before adjectives or adverbs to express high degree. Cross-referenced with 'trop' (#163).
entries.usage: Invariable. Requires liaison /z/ before vowel sounds.

examples.sentence: Ce gâteau est très bon.
examples.translation: This cake is very good.

examples.sentence: Elle parle très lentement.
examples.translation: She speaks very slowly.

examples.sentence: Si cette voiture était très rapide, je l'achèterais.
examples.translation: If this car were very fast, I would buy it.

examples.sentence: Cet article est très apprécié par les lecteurs.
examples.translation: This article is highly appreciated by readers.

entries.intro: Denotes addition (also/too) or comparison ('aussi... que' - as... as).
entries.usage: Invariable. In comparison, goes before the adjective.

examples.sentence: Elle parle français et elle parle aussi anglais.
examples.translation: She speaks French and she also speaks English.

examples.sentence: Il est aussi grand que son père.
examples.translation: He is as tall as his father.

examples.sentence: Si j'avais aussi peur, je ne le ferais pas.
examples.translation: If I were also this scared, I wouldn't do it.

examples.sentence: Cette méthode est aussi recommandée par les médecins.
examples.translation: This method is also recommended by doctors.

entries.intro: Refers to human intellect/mind, ghost/spirit, or wit/humor.
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: esprits. Requires 'l'' (l'esprit) in singular. Liaison /t/.

examples.sentence: Il a un esprit très vif.
examples.translation: He has a very sharp mind.

examples.sentence: Les esprits calmes prennent de bonnes décisions.
examples.translation: Calm minds make good decisions.

examples.sentence: Si tu avais l'esprit tranquille, tu dormirais mieux.
examples.translation: If you had a quiet mind, you would sleep better.

examples.sentence: Ce texte a été traduit dans l'esprit de l'auteur.
examples.translation: This text was translated in the spirit of the author.

entries.intro: The physical heart, or emotional center (love/courage) and geographical center (heart of city). Spelled with ligature 'œ' (cœur).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: cœurs. 'De tout cœur' (wholeheartedly).

examples.sentence: Son cœur bat la chamade.
examples.translation: His/Her heart is racing.

examples.sentence: L'hôtel est situé au cœur de la ville.
examples.translation: The hotel is situated in the heart of the city.

examples.sentence: Si tu écoutais ton cœur, tu viendrais.
examples.translation: If you listened to your heart, you would come.

examples.sentence: Le patient a été opéré à cœur ouvert.
examples.translation: The patient was operated on open heart.

entries.intro: The standard affirmative response particle. Opposite of 'non' (#169).
entries.usage: Invariable. Do not perform liaison before 'oui'.

examples.sentence: Avez-vous faim? Oui, un peu.
examples.translation: Are you hungry? Yes, a little.

examples.sentence: Elle a répondu oui à sa proposition.
examples.translation: She replied yes to his proposal.

examples.sentence: Si la réponse était oui, nous serions ravis.
examples.translation: If the answer were yes, we would be delighted.

examples.sentence: Le oui a été majoritairement voté lors du référendum.
examples.translation: Yes was mostly voted during the referendum.

entries.intro: The standard negative response particle. Opposite of 'oui' (#168).
entries.usage: Invariable. Used in negation and compounds.

examples.sentence: Voulez-vous sortir? Non, je préfère rester.
examples.translation: Do you want to go out? No, I prefer to stay.

examples.sentence: Il a dit non à ma demande.
examples.translation: He said no to my request.

examples.sentence: Si la réponse était non, nous chercherions une autre solution.
examples.translation: If the answer were no, we would look for another solution.

examples.sentence: Le non a été majoritairement exprimé.
examples.translation: No was mostly expressed.

entries.intro: Coordinating conjunction of consequence introducing a logical deduction.
entries.usage: Invariable. Pronunciation: final -c is usually pronounced /k/.

examples.sentence: Je pense, donc je suis.
examples.translation: I think, therefore I am. (Descartes)

examples.sentence: Il n'a pas révisé, il a donc échoué.
examples.translation: He did not revise, so he failed.

examples.sentence: Si tu partais, donc tout s'effondrerait.
examples.translation: If you left, therefore everything would collapse.

examples.sentence: Ce projet est donc soutenu par le maire.
examples.translation: This project is thus supported by the mayor.

entries.intro: A passenger car, automobile, or train coach.
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: voitures. 'En voiture' (by car / all aboard).

examples.sentence: Ma voiture est en panne.
examples.translation: My car is broken down.

examples.sentence: Elle conduit sa voiture prudemment.
examples.translation: She drives her car carefully.

examples.sentence: Si j'avais une voiture, je partirais en week-end.
examples.translation: If I had a car, I would go away for the weekend.

examples.sentence: La voiture a été vendue hier soir.
examples.translation: The car was sold yesterday evening.

entries.intro: A letter of the alphabet, or a written message sent by mail.
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: lettres.

examples.sentence: J'écris une lettre à mon grand-père.
examples.translation: I am writing a letter to my grandfather.

examples.sentence: Il y a six lettres dans ce mot.
examples.translation: There are six letters in this word.

examples.sentence: Si tu m'envoyais une lettre, je serais ravi.
examples.translation: If you sent me a letter, I would be delighted.

examples.sentence: La lettre a été distribuée par le facteur.
examples.translation: The letter was delivered by the postman.

entries.intro: A difficult question, source of trouble, or mathematical exercise.
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: problèmes. 'Pas de problème' (no problem).

examples.sentence: C'est un problème très complexe.
examples.translation: This is a very complex problem.

examples.sentence: Il a résolu le problème de mathématiques.
examples.translation: He solved the math problem.

examples.sentence: Si nous avions un problème, nous t'appellerions.
examples.translation: If we had a problem, we would call you.

examples.sentence: Le problème a été résolu rapidement.
examples.translation: The problem was solved quickly.

entries.intro: A mental concept, suggestion, thought, or opinion.
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: idées. Requires 'l'' (l'idée).

examples.sentence: C'est une excellente idée.
examples.translation: That is an excellent idea.

examples.sentence: J'ai l'idée de faire un gâteau.
examples.translation: I have the idea of making a cake.

examples.sentence: Si j'avais une bonne idée, je la partagerais.
examples.translation: If I had a good idea, I would share it.

examples.sentence: Cette idée est largement partagée par le groupe.
examples.translation: This idea is widely shared by the group.

entries.intro: Adverb of time indicating an action completed prior to the current time. Opposite of 'pas encore' (not yet).
entries.usage: Invariable.

examples.sentence: J'ai déjà fini mes devoirs.
examples.translation: I have already finished my homework.

examples.sentence: Es-tu déjà allé à Rome?
examples.translation: Have you already gone to Rome?

examples.sentence: Si tu avais déjà mangé, tu n'aurais pas faim.
examples.translation: If you had already eaten, you wouldn't be hungry.

examples.sentence: Cette leçon a été déjà apprise par les élèves.
examples.translation: This lesson has already been learned by the students.

entries.intro: Indicates continuation of a state (still), repetition (again), or addition (more).
entries.usage: Invariable.

examples.sentence: Il pleut encore ce matin.
examples.translation: It is still raining this morning.

examples.sentence: Je veux encore un peu d'eau.
examples.translation: I want a little more water.

examples.sentence: Si tu dormais encore, je ne te réveillerais pas.
examples.translation: If you were still sleeping, I wouldn't wake you.

examples.sentence: Ce sujet is encore étudié par les chercheurs.
examples.translation: This topic is still studied by researchers.

entries.intro: Preposition meaning at the home/office/workspace of someone, or typical behavior among a group.
entries.usage: Invariable. Followed by stressed pronoun or noun.

examples.sentence: Je vais chez le médecin aujourd'hui.
examples.translation: I am going to the doctor's office today.

examples.sentence: Elle reste chez elle ce soir.
examples.translation: She is staying at her home tonight.

examples.sentence: Si nous dinions chez toi, j'apporterais le dessert.
examples.translation: If we had dinner at your place, I would bring the dessert.

examples.sentence: L'ordre est respecté chez cette espèce animale.
examples.translation: Order is respected among this animal species.

entries.intro: A query, interrogation, or topic under discussion. Cross-referenced with 'réponse' (#184).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: questions. 'Poser une question' (to ask a question).

examples.sentence: Je pose une question au professeur.
examples.translation: I am asking the teacher a question.

examples.sentence: Cette question est sur toutes les lèvres.
examples.translation: This question is on everyone's lips.

examples.sentence: Si tu me posais une question, je te répondrais.
examples.translation: If you asked me a question, I would reply.

examples.sentence: La question a été débattue pendant des heures.
examples.translation: The question was debated for hours.

entries.intro: Acts as a preposition of direction (towards) or approximate time (around), or a masculine noun meaning a line of poetry/verse.
entries.usage: Invariable preposition. As a noun, plural: vers.

examples.sentence: Il marche vers la station.
examples.translation: He walks towards the station.

examples.sentence: J'arriverai vers huit heures.
examples.translation: I will arrive around eight o'clock.

examples.sentence: Si nous courions vers la sortie, nous serions sauvés.
examples.translation: If we ran towards the exit, we would be saved.

examples.sentence: Ce vers a été écrit par Victor Hugo.
examples.translation: This verse was written by Victor Hugo.

entries.intro: Preposition of space or relationship indicating intermediate position between two entities, or among a group.
entries.usage: Invariable.

examples.sentence: La table est placée entre les deux chaises.
examples.translation: The table is placed between the two chairs.

examples.sentence: Entre nous, cette affaire est suspecte.
examples.translation: Between us, this matter is suspicious.

examples.sentence: Si tu choisissais entre le thé et le café, ce serait bien.
examples.translation: If you chose between tea and coffee, it would be good.

examples.sentence: La paix a été conclue entre les deux pays.
examples.translation: Peace was concluded between the two countries.

entries.intro: Indicates temporal duration starting in the past and continuing into the present.
entries.usage: Invariable. Requires present tense in French if the action is still ongoing.

examples.sentence: J'habite à Lyon depuis deux ans.
examples.translation: I have lived in Lyon for two years.

examples.sentence: Il n'a rien mangé depuis hier.
examples.translation: He has eaten nothing since yesterday.

examples.sentence: Si tu attendais depuis hier, tu serais fatigué.
examples.translation: If you had been waiting since yesterday, you would be tired.

examples.sentence: Ce monument est surveillé depuis l'accident.
examples.translation: This monument has been monitored since the accident.

entries.intro: Preposition denoting duration of an action (during/for), or a masculine noun meaning a counterpart.
entries.usage: Invariable preposition. 'Pendant que' (while).

examples.sentence: Je dors pendant la nuit.
examples.translation: I sleep during the night.

examples.sentence: Il a plu pendant trois jours.
examples.translation: It rained for three days.

examples.sentence: Si tu étudiais pendant les vacances, tu réussirais.
examples.translation: If you studied during the holidays, you would succeed.

examples.sentence: La route a été bloquée pendant la tempête.
examples.translation: The road was blocked during the storm.

entries.intro: Indicates limit in space, time, or degree. Translates as until, up to, or as far as.
entries.usage: Requires elision: 'jusqu'à' (until / up to) or 'jusqu'ici' (until here).

examples.sentence: Je travaille jusqu'à six heures.
examples.translation: I work until six o'clock.

examples.sentence: Il est au bout du chemin.
examples.translation: He is at the end of the path.

examples.sentence: Si tu marchais jusqu'à la gare, tu me verrais.
examples.translation: If you walked to the station, you would see me.

examples.sentence: La vérité a été révélée jusqu'aux moindres détails.
examples.translation: The truth was revealed down to the minor details.

entries.intro: A reply, answer, or solution to a question. Cross-referenced with 'répondre' (#110) and 'question' (#178).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: réponses. 'En réponse à' (in response to).

examples.sentence: J'attends ta réponse avec impatience.
examples.translation: I wait for your answer with impatience.

examples.sentence: Cette réponse est correcte.
examples.translation: This answer is correct.

examples.sentence: Si je trouvais la bonne réponse, je la partagerais.
examples.translation: If I found the correct answer, I would share it.

examples.sentence: La réponse a été envoyée par courriel hier.
examples.translation: The answer was sent by email yesterday.

entries.intro: A bedroom or room in a house, or a political legislative body.
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: chambres. 'Chambre d'hôtel' (hotel room).

examples.sentence: Ma chambre est à l'étage.
examples.translation: My bedroom is upstairs.

examples.sentence: Elle range sa chambre tous les week-ends.
examples.translation: She tidies her room every weekend.

examples.sentence: Si la chambre était plus grande, je mettrais un bureau.
examples.translation: If the bedroom were larger, I would put a desk.

examples.sentence: La chambre d'amis est préparée pour les invités.
examples.translation: The guest room is prepared for the guests.

entries.intro: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs. Cross-referenced with 'chaise' (#192) and 'mettre' (#122).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: tables. 'À table!' (dinner is ready / to the table).

examples.sentence: Le dîner est sur la table.
examples.translation: Dinner is on the table.

examples.sentence: Il nettoie la table en bois.
examples.translation: He cleans the wooden table.

examples.sentence: Si la table était plus longue, nous serions plus à l'aise.
examples.translation: If the table were longer, we would be more comfortable.

examples.sentence: Le repas est servi sur la grande table.
examples.translation: The meal is served on the large table.

entries.intro: Indicates manner (in this way) or consequence (thus/so). 'Ainsi que' (as well as).
entries.usage: Invariable.

examples.sentence: Il a fait ainsi son travail.
examples.translation: He did his work in this way.

examples.sentence: C'est ainsi que l'histoire se termine.
examples.translation: It is in this way that the story ends.

examples.sentence: Si tu faisais ainsi, tu gagnerais du temps.
examples.translation: If you did so, you would save time.

examples.sentence: Les règles ont été ainsi rédigées par l'avocat.
examples.translation: The rules were thus drafted by the lawyer.

entries.intro: Compound adverb expressing absolute affirmation or agreement. Note the accent circonflexe on 'sûr'.
entries.usage: Invariable.

examples.sentence: Puis-je emprunter ce livre? Bien sûr.
examples.translation: Can I borrow this book? Of course.

examples.sentence: Elle sera là ce soir, bien sûr.
examples.translation: She will be there tonight, of course.

examples.sentence: Si tu m'invitais, je viendrais bien sûr.
examples.translation: If you invited me, I would come of course.

examples.sentence: L'autorisation a été bien sûr accordée par la police.
examples.translation: Authorization was of course granted by the police.

entries.intro: Expresses possibility, probability, or uncertainty. Formed by peut (can) + être (be).
entries.usage: Invariable.

examples.sentence: Il viendra peut-être demain.
examples.translation: He will perhaps come tomorrow.

examples.sentence: C'est peut-être la solution.
examples.translation: This is perhaps the solution.

examples.sentence: Si je m'entraînais, je serais peut-être sélectionné.
examples.translation: If I practiced, I would perhaps be selected.

examples.sentence: La vérité sera peut-être découverte par le détective.
examples.translation: The truth will perhaps be discovered by the detective.

entries.intro: Subordinating conjunction of time. Formal equivalent of 'quand' (#172).
entries.usage: Requires elision before vowels/h: 'lorsqu'il'. Invariable.

examples.sentence: Je lis lorsqu'il pleut.
examples.translation: I read when it rains. (Elision 'lorsqu'il')

examples.sentence: Lorsque tu seras prêt, nous partirons.
examples.translation: When you are ready, we will leave.

examples.sentence: Si tu m'appelais lorsque tu as un problème, je t'aiderais.
examples.translation: If you called me when you have a problem, I would help you.

examples.sentence: La lumière s'allume lorsqu'une présence est détectée.
examples.translation: The light turns on when a presence is detected.

entries.intro: Conjunction introducing an obvious or already known cause/justification. Equivalent: since, seeing that.
entries.usage: Requires elision before vowels/h: 'puisqu'elle'. Invariable.

examples.sentence: Puisque tu es là, aide-moi.
examples.translation: Since you are here, help me.

examples.sentence: Il a réussi puisqu'il a beaucoup travaillé.
examples.translation: He succeeded because (since) he worked hard.

examples.sentence: Si tu refusais puisqu'il fait nuit, je comprendrais.
examples.translation: If you refused since it is night, I would understand.

examples.sentence: L'autorisation est retirée puisqu'aucun respect n'a été montré.
examples.translation: Authorization is withdrawn since no respect was shown.

entries.intro: A seat with a back, typically with four legs, for one person. Cross-referenced with 'table' (#186) and 's'asseoir' (to sit).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: chaises.

examples.sentence: Il est assis sur une chaise.
examples.translation: He is sitting on a chair.

examples.sentence: Nous avons besoin de quatre chaises.
examples.translation: We need four chairs.

examples.sentence: Si la chaise était plus confortable, je travaillerais mieux.
examples.translation: If the chair were more comfortable, I would work better.

examples.sentence: La chaise de bureau a été cassée par le chat.
examples.translation: The office chair was broken by the cat.

entries.intro: Distributive determiner referring individually to all members of a group. Cross-referenced with 'chacun' (#200).
entries.usage: Invariable. Placed before singular nouns only.

examples.sentence: Chaque étudiant a un dictionnaire.
examples.translation: Each student has a dictionary.

examples.sentence: Je lis chaque soir avant de dormir.
examples.translation: I read every evening before sleeping.

examples.sentence: Si chaque citoyen payait sa part, tout irait bien.
examples.translation: If each citizen paid their share, everything would be fine.

examples.sentence: Chaque arbre est planté par le garde forestier.
examples.translation: Each tree is planted by the forest ranger.

entries.intro: An educational institution for children, or a style/movement in art/science. Requires elision (l'école).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: écoles. 'À l'école' (at school).

examples.sentence: Mon fils va à l'école le matin.
examples.translation: My son goes to school in the morning.

examples.sentence: L'école est fermée pour les vacances.
examples.translation: The school is closed for the holidays.

examples.sentence: Si l'école était plus proche, nous irions à pied.
examples.translation: If the school were closer, we would walk there.

examples.sentence: L'école a été construite par la commune.
examples.translation: The school was built by the municipality.

entries.intro: Indefinite determiner/pronoun denoting a moderate number of elements.
entries.usage: Invariable. Plural only.

examples.sentence: J'ai visité plusieurs musées à Rome.
examples.translation: I visited several museums in Rome.

examples.sentence: Plusieurs d'entre eux sont déjà là.
examples.translation: Several of them are already here.

examples.sentence: Si plusieurs personnes se plaignaient, la règle changerait.
examples.translation: If several people complained, the rule would change.

examples.sentence: Plusieurs options ont été étudiées par la commission.
examples.translation: Several options were studied by the commission.

entries.intro: Masculine plural form of 'tout' denoting completeness. Opposite of 'rien' (#198).
entries.usage: Masculine plural. Pronunciation: final -s is silent as determiner; pronounced /tus/ as pronoun.

examples.sentence: Tous les enfants sont présents.
examples.translation: All the children are present.

examples.sentence: Ils sont tous venus.
examples.translation: They all came.

examples.sentence: Si tous étaient d'accord, nous signerions le contrat.
examples.translation: If all were in agreement, we would sign the contract.

examples.sentence: Les dossiers ont été tous vérifiés par le chef.
examples.translation: The files were all verified by the boss.

entries.intro: Feminine plural form of 'tout' denoting completeness. Opposite of 'rien' (#198).
entries.usage: Feminine plural. Pronounced /tut/.

examples.sentence: Toutes les filles chantent ensemble.
examples.translation: All the girls sing together.

examples.sentence: Elles sont toutes arrivées.
examples.translation: They have all arrived.

examples.sentence: Si toutes les portes étaient fermées, ce serait sûr.
examples.translation: If all the doors were closed, it would be safe.

examples.sentence: Toutes les erreurs ont été corrigées par le professeur.
examples.translation: All the errors were corrected by the teacher.

entries.intro: A desk/table, workplace/office, or governing department. Cross-referenced with 'travail' (#139).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: bureaux. 'Bureau de tabac' (tobacco shop).

examples.sentence: Mon bureau est encombré de papiers.
examples.translation: My desk is cluttered with papers.

examples.sentence: Il travaille dans un bureau à Paris.
examples.translation: He works in an office in Paris.

examples.sentence: Si j'avais un grand bureau, j'y installerais mon ordinateur.
examples.translation: If I had a large office, I would install my computer there.

examples.sentence: Les dossiers ont été laissés sur le bureau.
examples.translation: The files were left on the desk.

entries.intro: Acts as a negative pronoun (nobody, paired with 'ne') or a feminine noun meaning a person.
entries.usage: Pronoun is masculine (in agreements) and requires 'ne'. Noun is feminine.

examples.sentence: Il n'y a personne dans la salle.
examples.translation: There is nobody in the room.

examples.sentence: C'est une personne très gentille.
examples.translation: She/He is a very kind person.

examples.sentence: Si personne ne venait, la fête serait annulée.
examples.translation: If nobody came, the party would be cancelled.

examples.sentence: Cette personne a été arrêtée par la police.
examples.translation: This person was arrested by the police.

entries.intro: Distributive pronoun referring individually to all members of a group.
entries.usage: Feminine form: chacune.

examples.sentence: Chacun a reçu une invitation.
examples.translation: Each one received an invitation.

examples.sentence: Chacun doit faire son devoir.
examples.translation: Everyone must do their duty.

examples.sentence: Si chacun donnait un euro, nous serions riches.
examples.translation: If everyone gave one euro, we would be rich.

examples.sentence: Chacun d'entre eux a été interrogé par le juge.
examples.translation: Each of them was questioned by the judge.
